formulae:
1. For Final Nifty Levels at or above 104% of Initial Nifty the product offers a PR of 150%  for the first ~13% rise in Nifty.  
2. For Final Nifty Levels between 117% to 120% of initial Nifty level product offers PR of 1816.667%(1666.667%+150%) after which coupon is capped at 74%. 
3. For Final Nifty Levels below Initial Nifty Level principal is protected till 20% fall in Nifty after which Principal erodes by 1.25 times Nifty Performance.
